how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for One Stop Center Adoni Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.kurnool.ap.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the One Stop Center Adoni for various contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies available for Case Worker, Para Medical, and Psycho Social posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for One Stop Center Adoni Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form and send it by post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Case Worker?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Law, Social Work, Sociology, Social Science, or Psychology with 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, the application fee for SC/ST candidates as well as General/OBC candidates is Nil.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 39 years, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the notification and application form from the official website at www.kurnool.ap.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Scrutiny and Document Verification conducted by the organization.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for One Stop Center Adoni positions?
faq.answer: The job type for all selected candidates under this recruitment drive is purely contractual.
